h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhiwandi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhiwandi

items.pText: Bhiwandi is only about 18 km from our factory in Vasai East, which makes it one of the closest towns we supply. It is best known for its power looms and the large warehousing belt along the highways, and it also has growing residential complexes and schools. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for all of these and installs it with our own team or a local dealer.

Being this close helps in practical ways. Our installation team does not have to travel far, so small follow-up jobs, such as adding a piece next year, are simple to arrange. The bigger planning issue is the monsoon. In Thane district it runs from June to September with very heavy rain. We suggest finishing installation before the rains, or scheduling it once they ease, and approving the layout early enough for manufacturing to finish in time.

items.q: How close is your factory to Bhiwandi?
items.a: Our factory in Vasai East is about 18 km from Bhiwandi. You can reach our sales team Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM, on +91 902 830 2266.

items.q: When should a Bhiwandi project be installed?
items.a: Ideally before June or after the heavy rain ends, since grouting and rubber flooring need dry ground. Plan the layout approval early so manufacturing finishes in time.

items.q: Who installs playground equipment in Bhiwandi?
items.a: Our installation team or a local dealer, working from our Vasai factory nearby. Posts are grouted or the equipment is set self-standing, depending on the ground.
